# Mahir Malik — AI Engineer

> Mahir Malik is an AI engineer building agent systems and interactive machine-learning tools, including Sellable and Confluence.

## Site
- [Home](https://www.mahirmalik.in/): Portfolio of Mahir Malik, AI engineer.
- [About](https://www.mahirmalik.in/about): Profile, working approach, skills, and contact details.
- [Projects](https://www.mahirmalik.in/work): Software projects and case studies.
- [Articles](https://www.mahirmalik.in/writing): Technical writing on agent systems and machine learning.

## Projects
- [Sellable](https://www.mahirmalik.in/work/sellable) (Agentic Commerce): Sellable is an agentic commerce prototype where buyer and seller agents negotiate within explicit policy limits. It combines a machine-readable storefront, deterministic transaction checks, single-use consent, Razorpay test-mode payments, and an audit trail.
- [Confluence](https://www.mahirmalik.in/work/confluence) (ML Visualization): Confluence is an interactive machine-learning playground powered by real scikit-learn compute. It pairs 38 algorithms and 25 datasets with live decision boundaries, training playback, prediction explanations, and reproducible Python exports.
- Helion (Agent Harness; in progress): Helion is an agent harness in development for terminal and desktop workflows. It is designed to show agent runs, allow mid-run steering, and gate tool calls for human approval.

## Articles
- [Jev Explained: The Small Model That Decides Instead of Writing](https://www.mahirmalik.in/writing/jev-system-one-model-explained) (2026-09-20): Jev by TypeSafe AI is a System One model for fast typed decisions: how its Choice, Score and Noul primitives work, what it costs, and where it fits beside an LLM.
- [Context vs Loop vs Harness Engineering: The New Stack Behind AI Agents](https://www.mahirmalik.in/writing/context-vs-loop-vs-harness-engineering) (2026-09-13): How context engineering, harness engineering, and loop engineering differ, where they overlap, and how to build a simple production-style agent system.
- [I made a visualization tool for ML algorithms](https://www.mahirmalik.in/writing/i-made-a-visualization-tool-for-ml-algorithms) (2026-08-28): Confluence is a playground for learning ML by watching it work: 38 real scikit-learn algorithms, decision boundaries you can poke at, and training you can scrub through frame by frame.
